verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a homepage claim that marketers can "see which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue" [loops-docs-16]. That glancingly covers conversion attribution per email, but nothing documents the rest of the reporting story. missing for 10: documented open, click, and unsubscribe metrics; per-campaign reporting views; per-automation/workflow-step breakdowns; time-series trends; API or MCP access to analytics; independent or hands-on corroboration.
